body.x: Urbanears(www.urbanears.com), a maker of distinctively designed headphones, presented "Plattan ADV" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.(Video: Rebecca & Fiona(Swedish DJ Duo) joined at the Urbanears booth at CES 2015 with some great music and style)The Plattan ADV Wireless headphone(Plattan ADV) is the first Bluetooth headphone in the Urbanears line-up. It comes with a built-in microphone, a swipe interface on the ear cup and it is ready for 8-hours solid playtime on a charge. Also, there are innovative features like fully removable and machine washable headband, collapsible structure, ZoundPlug and equalizer.Plattan ADV has a new 3D hinge technology that automatically adjusts to the users’ ears and head for a soft and comfortable fit. The headband of this earphone is made of fabric and can be easily snapped off and thrown in the wash. Also it comes with an interchangeable cable, allowing you to choose to wear on either the left or right side. Everything is controlled by taps and swipes and the headphones are collapsible for convenient storage.Bluetooth controls are handled via the ear cup, which features the swipe interface for answering calls, adjusting volume and switching tracks. The headphone can be paired wirelessly with any Bluetooth device within a 10-meter range (33 feet), and remembers up to eight previously paired units.
